k-founder.title: Founder $Founder GTA 6 coins
k-founder.sourceSays: Posts say $Founder grew from a "Fundador" diamond badge spotted in a DacityCoin screenshot, tied to a GTA 6 theme; an account named Founder says fees will buy GTA 6 for holders. Unverified.
k-founder.reason: Posts of Nov 18 (17:13-20:30 UTC) describe the origin (Fundador badge in DacityCoin screenshot, GTA 6 fee promise) and match the coins' pool ages of 6-9h; most other posts are call-group shills, not cited.
